# LinkedIn Draft - 2026-08-12

Liquid AI released LFM2.5-2.6B, a 2.6B open-weights agentic model with 128K context and tool calling that runs at ~220 tok/s on an M5 Max in under 2.5 GB.

Went through 80 links today. Here's what made the brief:

1. Liquid AI ships LFM2.5-2.6B — an on-device agentic model with 128K context and tool calling
   A credible local-first option for routing cheap agent calls off hosted APIs, on hardware already on the desk.

2. Anthropic now watermarks Claude text and signs generated files with C2PA metadata
   Changes what you can assume about the provenance of AI-generated assets you ship, and it applies to output already in your pipeline.

3. Mcptoon — token-efficient MCP CLI client (97% less on tool discovery)
   Directly attacks a recurring cost in multi-host MCP setups, is trivially reversible, and requires no change to the servers themselves.

4. Mistral makes regional endpoints GA — pin inference to the EU or US, plus a priority uptime tier
   Data-residency guarantees moving from roadmap to GA changes what you can promise EU customers in a contract today.

5. Show HN: a tiny LLM running at 21,000 tok/s on a $250 KV260 FPGA
   An early signal on cheap dedicated inference hardware; no action today.
